brief: A phone charging station: a closed box with a cover that lets a cable pass through.
costSource: token-equivalent at Muse Spark Open shared rates, info only: the Dedicated Endpoint bills GPU seconds while up (.spend/modal-dedicated.jsonl)

requirements.evidence: Single hex base piece:0,0,0;full enclosed with cover:0,0,0;full;top, cover:0,0,0;full;bottom and 6 solid end caps (cap:0,0,0;*;30/90/150/210/270/330) — forms a fully enclosed cell, verified meshClash clear

requirements.requirement: Cover that lets a cable pass through
requirements.evidence: Top cover is type 'cable' (cover:0,0,0;full;top stem cable) — manufactured with cable-entry slot for charger lead; staged with phone prop on top and cable-coil prop beside to show use

finish.summary: Built single-cell closed box (220×80×218 mm) with solid caps on all 6 side faces, solid bottom cover and cable-type top cover providing integral cable pass-through. Staged with phone on lid and coiled cable on bench; check_build clear, no mesh clash.

events.text: Your charging box needs a cable pass-through — I'll build a closed box to hold your phone.
